title: "Analysis"
format: html

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(gtsummary)
data_ppt <- read.csv("../data/rawdata_participants.csv")

data_task <- read.csv("../data/rawdata_task.csv")

table(data_ppt$media_professional, useNA = "ifany")

# Create demographics comparison table
demo_table <- data_ppt %>%
  select(
    media_professional,
    Gender,
    Age,
    Education,
    Discipline,
    Student,
    Ethnicity,
    Country
  ) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    by = media_professional,  # Group by TRUE vs FALSE
    missing = "no"            # Keep missing values as their own category
  ) %>%
  add_p() %>%                  # Add statistical test for each variable
  modify_header(label ~ "Media Professional") %>%
  bold_labels()

demo_table



```
